gbm_population_evidence.quote: Clinical Study of an Dendritic and Glioma Cells Fusion Vaccine With IL-12 for Treatment-naïve GBM Patients.

candidate_evidence.quote: In immunotherapy phase, besides maintenance chemotherapy with TMZ, Fusion cells will be administered with IL-12 to enhance the immunity of patients.
Given subcutaneously at dose of 6ug twice for interval of one hour.

candidate_flag.reason: IL-12 is the only possible candidate and is given as an immune enhancer with the excluded DC/tumour fusion vaccine; could be read as a vaccine adjuvant (non-candidate).

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Treatment-naïve patients after Resection of Glioblastoma.

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Assays including Flow Cytometry and Elispot will be employed to determine if cellular and humoral immunity were induced by serial vaccination with DC/Tumor Fusion Cells and IL-12.

role_evidence.quote: Vaccine is derived from the participants dendritic cells and tumor cells.

agents.drug_class_hint: autologous dendritic cell-tumour cell fusion vaccine

role_evidence.quote: In immunotherapy phase, besides maintenance chemotherapy with TMZ, Fusion cells will be administered with IL-12 to enhance the immunity of patients.

flag.reason: May function only as an adjuvant to the excluded fusion vaccine rather than as an investigational candidate.

role_evidence.quote: In basic treatment phase, patients will receive concomitant radiation and TMZ-chemotherapy.

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, GBM standard of care

coder_notes: Stupp chemoradiation then maintenance TMZ plus DC/tumour fusion vaccine with subcutaneous IL-12. By analogy with the manual's 'pembrolizumab + investigational vaccine' example IL-12 is coded as the candidate, flagged uncertain. Immunological assays measure immunity induced by vaccine plus IL-12 jointly (target engagement coded yes; not specific to IL-12).
